## 5. Glossary (111 key terms)

### YouTube Algorithm
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-algorithm
**Definition:** The recommendation system that decides which videos appear in search results, suggested videos, and the homepage for each viewer.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Session Time
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/session-time
**Definition:** Total time a viewer spends on YouTube after watching your video. The algorithm prioritizes videos that keep people watching longer.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Click-Through Rate (CTR)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/click-through-rate
**Definition:** The percentage of viewers who click on your video after seeing it in search results, suggested videos, or the homepage.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Average View Duration (AVD)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/average-view-duration
**Definition:** The average minutes a viewer watches your video before leaving. Higher AVD signals engaging content to the algorithm.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Audience Retention
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/audience-retention
**Definition:** A graph showing what percentage of viewers watch each moment of your video. Used to identify where viewers lose interest.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Watch Time
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/watch-time
**Definition:** Total minutes viewers have spent watching your videos. Combined channel watch time is a key monetization and ranking metric.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Impressions
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/impressions
**Definition:** The number of times your video thumbnail is shown to viewers across search, suggested videos, homepage, and other surfaces.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Revenue Per Mille (RPM)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/revenue-per-mille
**Definition:** Your total estimated revenue per 1,000 video views, including ad revenue, memberships, and Super Chat combined.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Cost Per Mille (CPM)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/cost-per-mille
**Definition:** The amount advertisers pay per 1,000 ad impressions on your videos. You earn 55% of this after YouTube's cut.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### YouTube Partner Program (YPP)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-partner-program
**Definition:** YouTube's monetization program that lets creators earn revenue from ads, memberships, and other features after meeting eligibility requirements.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Ad Revenue
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/ad-revenue
**Definition:** Money earned from ads displayed on your videos, split 55/45 between creator and YouTube after advertiser payments.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Demonetization
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/demonetization
**Definition:** When YouTube removes ads from a video or channel due to content that violates advertiser-friendly guidelines.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### YouTube Keyword Research
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-keyword-research
**Definition:** Finding search terms your target audience uses on YouTube to discover content, then optimizing videos to rank for those terms.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Long-Tail Keywords
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/long-tail-keywords
**Definition:** Specific, multi-word search phrases (4+ words) that have lower search volume but higher conversion rates and less competition.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Search Volume
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/search-volume
**Definition:** The number of times a keyword is searched on YouTube per month. Higher volume means more potential viewers but typically more competition.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Keyword Difficulty
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/keyword-difficulty
**Definition:** A score (0-100) estimating how hard it is to rank for a keyword based on competition from established videos and channels.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Title Optimization
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/title-optimization
**Definition:** Writing video titles that include target keywords while maximizing click-through rate through emotional triggers and curiosity gaps.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### YouTube Tags
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-tags
**Definition:** Keywords added to video metadata to help YouTube understand the content and context of your video for search and recommendations.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Description Optimization
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/description-optimization
**Definition:** Structuring video descriptions with target keywords, timestamps, links, and CTAs to improve search ranking and viewer engagement.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Transcript SEO
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/transcript-seo
**Definition:** Using your video's auto-generated captions and transcript as SEO content that YouTube indexes and matches to search queries.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Thumbnail Optimization
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/thumbnail-optimization
**Definition:** Designing custom video thumbnails that increase click-through rate through contrast, emotion, text, and visual hierarchy.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Video Chapters / Timestamps
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-chapters
**Definition:** Time-stamped sections in video descriptions that let viewers jump to specific parts and appear as search result links.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Closed Captions (CC)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/closed-captions
**Definition:** On-screen text of video dialogue that improves accessibility, SEO, and viewer engagement across languages.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Video Sitemap
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-sitemap
**Definition:** An XML file that helps Google discover and index your video content with metadata like title, description, and duration.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### YouTube Search Ranking Factors
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-search-ranking-factors
**Definition:** The signals YouTube's search algorithm uses to determine which videos rank highest for a given search query.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Dwell Time
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/dwell-time
**Definition:** How long a viewer spends watching your video before returning to search results. Longer dwell time signals relevance to the algorithm.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Keyword Cannibalization
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/keyword-cannibalization
**Definition:** When multiple videos on your channel compete for the same search keyword, splitting views and weakening your ranking potential.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### YouTube Shorts
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-shorts
**Definition:** Vertical short-form videos (up to 60 seconds) that compete with TikTok and Instagram Reels, with unique algorithm and monetization rules.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Shorts Monetization
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/shorts-monetization
**Definition:** The specific requirements and revenue rules for earning money from YouTube Shorts, including the Shorts Fund and ad revenue sharing.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Video Hook
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/video-hook
**Definition:** The first 5-15 seconds of a video designed to grab viewer attention and convince them to keep watching past the initial drop-off point.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Content Pillar
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-pillar
**Definition:** A core topic your channel consistently creates videos about, forming the foundation of your content strategy and audience expectations.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Evergreen Content
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/evergreen-content
**Definition:** Videos that remain relevant and searchable for months or years after publication, consistently generating views without ongoing promotion.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Playlist SEO
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/playlist-optimization
**Definition:** Optimizing YouTube playlists with keyword-rich titles and descriptions so they rank in search and trigger auto-play sessions.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Cards and End Screens
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/cards-end-screens
**Definition:** Interactive elements on YouTube videos that link viewers to other videos, playlists, channels, or external sites during and after playback.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Channel Audit
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-audit
**Definition:** A systematic review of your YouTube channel's performance, SEO, content gaps, and growth opportunities across all metrics.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Competitor Analysis
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/competitor-analysis
**Definition:** Analyzing competing YouTube channels to identify their strengths, weaknesses, keyword targets, and content strategies you can learn from.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Content Gap Analysis
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/content-gap-analysis
**Definition:** Finding topics your audience searches for that your competitors haven't covered, creating opportunities for high-impact content.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Call to Action (CTA)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/call-to-action
**Definition:** A prompt telling viewers to take a specific action — subscribe, watch another video, comment, or visit a link — placed strategically in videos.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### A/B Testing (Thumbnail Testing)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/ab-testing
**Definition:** Testing multiple versions of a video thumbnail by showing different variants to segments of your audience and comparing CTR performance.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### YouTube Live Stream
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/youtube-live-stream
**Definition:** Real-time video broadcasting on YouTube that generates high engagement, notification triggers, and dedicated revenue through Super Chat.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Super Chat & Super Stickers
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/super-chat
**Definition:** Paid chat messages highlighted during live streams and Premieres. Creators earn 70% of the revenue from each purchase.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Channel Memberships
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/channel-memberships
**Definition:** Monthly subscription tiers where viewers pay for exclusive perks like badges, emoji, and members-only content from your channel.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Premieres
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/premieres
**Definition:** A scheduled first-time video debut that combines the live experience of a stream (real-time chat) with polished pre-recorded content.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Community Tab
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/community-tab
**Definition:** A social feed on your channel where you can post text updates, polls, images, and videos to engage subscribers between uploads.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Vertical Video (9:16)
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/vertical-video
**Definition:** Video shot in portrait orientation (9:16 aspect ratio) optimized for mobile-first viewing on YouTube Shorts and mobile feeds.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Mobile-First YouTube SEO
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/mobile-seo
**Definition:** Optimizing video content for mobile viewers who watch on small screens with different browsing behavior than desktop users.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Topic Authority
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/topic-authority
**Definition:** YouTube's assessment of your channel's expertise in a specific topic area, built through consistent, comprehensive coverage of related content.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Audience Demographics
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/audience-demographics
**Definition:** Age, gender, location, and device data about your viewers available in YouTube Analytics Studio.
**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Traffic Sources
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/traffic-sources

**Topic:** YouTube SEO

### Shorts Algorithm
**URL:** https://yt-seo-architect.vercel.app/glossary/shorts-algorithm
